[center]📱 [color=#ffe599][size=4][b]A real SNS, right inside your save[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center]OnlyFarms adds a fully working social network app to the game.[/center]
[center]Press a key (F9 by default, configurable), and the phone pops up on screen. That's it.[/center]
[center]🖼️ Photo collections for every character[/center]
[center]Every NPC has their own profile, complete with a banner and name, and inside, their [b]collections[/b]: themed photo albums ([i]"A walk through the valley"[/i], [i]"A visit to the beach"[/i]) that you unlock one image at a time by spending in-game gold.[/center]
[list]
[*]The price [b]rises progressively within each collection[/b], then resets for the next one — so every album has its own cost curve.[/*]
[*]Each collection can have its own intro text, with scrolling if you write more than fits.[/*]
[*]"Collection complete" badges and a "new content" indicator, so you always know what's left to see.[/*]
[/list][center]🔍 [color=#e06666][size=4][b]From Thumbnail to Full Screen[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center]Unlocked photos can be viewed enlarged right inside the phone, and with one more click, at [b]true full size, full screen[/b], with smooth navigation between images — using your mouse, the keyboard arrows, or a gamepad.[/center]
[center]🎮 Built for every kind of player[/center]
[list]
[*][b]Full gamepad support[/b]: navigate the entire phone (grids, lists, galleries, confirmation dialogs) with the D-Pad, confirm with A, go back with B.[/*]
[*][b]Keyboard[/b]: navigate photos with the left/right arrow keys.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse[/b]: regular clicks, plus scroll wheel to change pages or scroll through longer collection descriptions.[/*]
[/list][center][size=4][color=#93c47d]⚙️ [/color][b][color=#a4c2f4]Fully customizable[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] support: change the keybind, prices, and phone screen margins from an in-game menu, no file editing required.[/*]
[*][b]Translation support[/b] via SMAPI's standard i18n system — ships with English and Spanish, and is easy to translate into any other language.[/*]
[*]All content (phone frame, logo, portraits, banners, and the photo collections themselves) is entirely yours to provide — the mod doesn't bundle any third-party artwork, so you can theme it however you like.[/*]
[/list][center][/center]
